title: 第二十五章 醒转第二十六章 仙法在哪
content_zh:
李言此时已完全清楚了在自己身上发生的事情，这也是灰衫老者不惜浪费时间最终的结果。
李言记起他再次清醒时，老者不让他睁开眼的言语，此刻当然也明白了用意。
那时自己若清醒后睁眼，肯定是立即盘膝运功继续炼化药力了，体内刚被压制的火毒药力便会再次爆发。
自己何来再有运气遇见像灰衫老者这样具有仙法神通之人，那么等待自己的，今日就是第二次糊里糊涂死亡了。
想到这，李言已是心有余悸不已。
此时的老者身影已开始缥缈虚幻起来，连声音都有些飘忽不定了。
“好了，讲了这些，你想必已是知道我为何救你了？”
李言抬起头看向身影虚幻的老者，点头轻声道。
“小子当然明白，我应该就是你要寻找的‘癸水仙门’具有灵根之人。”
李言自灰衫老者讲述到他们五大古老门派寻找特殊体质灵根之人，就已猜到了，这对于他来说，可并不难猜。
刚才怎么没发现他晋级，可能是刚才李言昏迷时气息不稳，再加上刚冲入到凝气期一层，气息太弱罢了，现在随着李言的醒来，气息自然是慢慢显露出来了。
不过片刻后，他也就放下了心中疑窦，这四十九天李言可都是在他眼皮子底下修炼的，哪会有什么问题？
或者就是自己打入他体内的几股灵力起了作用，也或许是这小子体质有些特殊，只是自己多疑罢了。
李言觉得浑身有些发冷，猛地睁开双眼，顿觉眼前一片刺目阳光，晃得他又连忙闭上了双目，这时一个熟悉的声音传了过来。
灰衫老者此时缥缈的声音中竟然透露出不怀好意的笑声，但却不再说下去了，话锋一转说道。
刚才李言被他从水中捞出后，除了在他最初发出灵力救治时，李言有了那么一丝反应，接下来他又打入了几道灵力再无任何反应。
那么仙法在哪里？我又如何才能从这识海中走出去呢？”
日后，你可多在这水潭边修炼，这对我们水系为主的灵根是可以加强辅助效果的，季军师当初选择这个山谷做为府邸，也不是胡乱选择的，这里是附近唯一有些灵气的地方。
他脑中一闪，这个词不由自主的冒了出来，他确定这一想法后，更加清晰的感觉到那双眼睛自上到下，自里到外不停地扫视着自己。
他刚开始说话时还在边想边说，说到后来，习惯性的神识往李言身上一扫，不由得吃了一惊，随着李言的苏醒，李言身上的气息正在不断的变化增强。

“还什么掌门？话也没交代清楚，而且自己又莫名其妙的拜入了一个仙门，还是一个无根的仙门，现在也就只有自己一名弟子。
所以，为师只能一直在为你运功疗伤，现在你已无大碍，为师……咦？”
但旋即他又狐疑顿生，刚才他可是神识扫视数次了，现在这又当如何解释？
日后，随着你体内灵力的运转全身，隐藏于灵力中的毒素会不断壮大，同时会不断渗入肌肉、骨骼之内。
李言望着那些空中化作的水雾急道。
正在思忖间，眼前的水雾已是消散一空，随着水雾的消散，李言顿觉眼前一，然后就是一阵恍惚，已是一片漆黑。
不过，你要是能在一年之内把‘癸水真经’勤修苦炼，达到凝气期第一层顶峰之境，那时也许情况就或有一丝逆转机会了，说不定还有意外.嘿嘿嘿……”
你待会可以感应一下它的存在，它是一整套完整的仙法，从凝气期一直到大乘期，但你只能看到与自己法力境界相符的仙法内容。
“你这是修炼时引气入体岔了经脉，落入了水潭，为师刚才把你救上来，这都过去半刻钟左右了，你却一直处于昏迷状态。
他迟早会吸了你的灵力，下场不比毒发身亡好上多少，如果修炼我给的仙法，说不定你还有一搏的机会，你说你不修仙？”
所以，你现在要关心的还是怎么炼好‘葵水真经’，如何能逃出去吧？其他之事只有待你逃脱后，才有资格计划。”
李言听到他前半段话心中还有些迷惑，不知灰衫老者说着说着怎么有些不怀好意的笑起来，又听得老者说到洪元帅意图，不由眼睛一亮。
“仙……仙长，我……我不想修仙，我想回家和爹娘团聚。”
content_en:
Li Yan now fully understood what had happened to him, and this was the final result of the old man in gray shirt not wanting to waste time.
Li Yan remembered the old man's words not letting him open his eyes when he woke up again, and of course he understood the intention at this moment.
If he had woken up and opened his eyes at that time, he would have immediately crossed his legs and continued to refine the medicine, and the fire poison power that had just been suppressed in his body would explode again.
How could I ever have the luck to meet someone with magical powers like the old man in gray shirt? What awaited me would be my second confused death today.
Thinking of this, Li Yan was already frightened.
At this time, the old man's figure had begun to become ethereal and illusory, and even his voice became a little erratic.
"Okay, after talking about this, you must already know why I saved you?"
Li Yan raised his head and looked at the illusory old man, nodded and said softly.
"Of course I understand, kid. I should be the person with spiritual roots from the Guishui Immortal Sect that you are looking for."
Li Yan had guessed it since the old man in gray shirt told about their five ancient sects looking for people with special physical spiritual roots. This was not difficult for him to guess.
Why didn't I notice that he had advanced just now? Maybe it was because Li Yan's breath was unstable when he was unconscious, and because he had just rushed to the first level of Qi Condensation stage, his breath was too weak. Now as Li Yan wakes up, his breath is naturally slowly revealed.
But after a while, he put aside his doubts. Li Yan had been practicing under his nose for the past forty-nine days, so how could there be any problem?
Perhaps it was the few strands of spiritual power that I had penetrated into his body that had an effect, or maybe this kid had a special physique and I was just paranoid.
Li Yan felt a little chilled all over, and opened his eyes suddenly. He felt a dazzling sunlight in front of him, and he quickly closed his eyes again. At this time, a familiar voice came over.
The old man in gray shirt had a malicious laugh in his ethereal voice, but he stopped talking and changed the subject.
After Li Yan was fished out of the water by him just now, except when he first sent out spiritual power for treatment, Li Yan had a slight reaction, and then he injected several more spiritual powers and there was no reaction at all.
So where is the magic? How can I get out of this sea of ​​consciousness? "
In the future, you can practice more by this water pool. This can strengthen the auxiliary effect on our water-based spiritual roots. When Master Ji chose this valley as his residence, he did not choose it randomly. This is the only place with some spiritual energy nearby.
A flash occurred in his mind, and the word popped up involuntarily. After he confirmed this idea, he felt more clearly that the eyes were scanning him from top to bottom, from inside to outside.
When he first started speaking, he was still thinking and talking. Later, his habitual consciousness swept over Li Yan, and he couldn't help but be surprised. As Li Yan woke up, the aura on Li Yan's body was constantly changing and strengthening.
"What else is the leader? He didn't explain clearly, and he had inexplicably joined an immortal sect, a rootless one, and now he only had one disciple.
Therefore, my teacher can only continue to perform exercises and heal your injuries. Now that you are no longer seriously injured, my teacher... Huh? "
But immediately he became suspicious again. He had scanned it several times with his spiritual consciousness just now. How should he explain this now?
In the future, as the spiritual power in your body circulates throughout the body, the toxins hidden in the spiritual power will continue to grow and penetrate into the muscles and bones.
Li Yan looked at the mist that turned into the air and said anxiously.
While he was thinking about it, the mist in front of him had dissipated. As the mist dissipated, Li Yan suddenly felt a blur in front of his eyes, and then he was in a trance, and it was pitch black.
However, if you can practice the "Guishui Zhenjing" diligently within a year and reach the peak of the first level of the Qi Condensation Stage, then there may be a chance for the situation to be reversed, and maybe there will be an accident. Hehehe...…”
You can sense its existence later. It is a complete set of immortal magic, from the Qi Condensation stage to the Mahayana stage, but you can only see the content of the immortal magic that is consistent with your own magic realm.
"During cultivation, you diverted Qi into your body and diverted your meridians, falling into a pool of water. My master just rescued you. About half a quarter of an hour has passed, but you have been in a coma.
Sooner or later, he will absorb your spiritual power, and the end will be no better than death from poison. If you practice the immortal method I gave you, maybe you still have a chance to give it a try. You say you don't practice immortality? "
Therefore, what you need to care about now is how to practice the "Kui Shui Sutra" well and how to escape, right? You can only plan other things after you escape. "
Li Yan was still a little confused when he heard the first half of his words. He didn't know why the old man in gray shirt smiled maliciously as he spoke, and when he heard the old man talking about Marshal Hong's intention, his eyes lit up.
"Immortal...immortal chief, I...I don't want to become an immortal. I want to go home and reunite with my parents."
